actions.title: Approve channel/product/price mapping
actions.work: Choose supported channel/storefront/program routes and exact plan/cycle/seat products, prices/offers/terms and operator/provider prerequisites. Keep web invoice settings separate from store product prices.
actions.recheck: Approved mapping/configuration and CO01; current policy and actual enrollment/eligibility evidence.

actions.title: Server purchase verification and purchase ownership
actions.work: Implement trusted provider-specific verification bound to environment/app/product and server account/workspace intent; reject client flags/receipts as authority and cross-account purchase reuse.
actions.recheck: Genuine sandbox allowed/denied purchase/ownership/chain proof; CO03.

actions.title: Authenticated durable events and idempotency
actions.work: Implement protocol-specific receivers and durable purchase/event state, logical transaction dedup, concurrent claims, safe retries and acknowledgment/reconciliation. Google JWT/purchase refresh and Apple signed data are not generic interchangeable HMAC callbacks.
actions.recheck: Altered/replayed/reordered/concurrent/timeout/partial-failure tests with real provider authentication; CO04/CO08.

actions.title: Lifecycle/refund/restore and entitlement projection
actions.work: Define and implement cancellation/expiry/grace/hold/restore/refund/revocation, account suspension and independent entitlement-source precedence; preserve finance data and legitimate ownership.
actions.recheck: Actual provider lifecycle and device restore plus server effects/no duplicate terms; CO05.

actions.title: Capacity/plan changes and cross-channel rules
actions.work: Map Family/Business owner-inclusive seats and reserved invitations; preserve web algorithms/accepted invoices, explicitly map native product changes and scheduled capacity/ownership transfer/overlapping purchases.

actions.title: Native commerce UX and channel separation
actions.work: Implement approved billing bridge or qualifying access-only flow and remove unsupported payment CTAs from affected native channel; query correct products, handle cancel/relaunch and manage/restore while preserving web proof flow.
actions.recheck: Actual signed-build/device/storefront purchase UX, safe routes and server-consistent display; CO07/CO08.

actions.title: Preserve and directly verify manual commerce guards
actions.work: Retain server quotes/owner/seat locks, private proof binding, submitted amounts, review delegation/self-review rules, exact staff/MFA assurance and bounded manual/test grants; do not bypass AU/AM/Business/UF source/parity prerequisites.
actions.recheck: Direct hosted own/foreign/anonymous/staff/MFA/proof/retry cases with genuine actors; CO02 and earlier dependencies.

actions.title: Controlled sandbox rollout/operations and final proof
actions.work: Bind exact implementation/catalog/products/provider credentials/private configuration, separate recoverable actors, durable processing budgets/log privacy/retention/recovery/rollback and final artifact/declarations. Run bounded genuine acceptance then final re-audit.
actions.recheck: CO08 plus all relevant CO groups, provider/device effects and preservation/cleanup/rollback evidence.
